name: Platform launcher
responsibility: The bin archboard of the launcher packages: finds the platform package installed beside it and starts its executable with every argument
description: A POSIX shell script. It follows the link that the package manager made to the package, names the platform from uname, and looks for @archboard/cli-<platform> in the node_modules of the package and then of each directory above it, which covers the nested layout of npm and the hoisted layout of bun add -g. It starts the executable in its own place, so the exit status is the executable's. It refuses a platform that has no release, and a missing platform package with the advice not to omit optional dependencies.
